_comment: Physics profile for the Franka FR3 under Isaac Sim, consumed by run_isaac_sim.py.
Joint names, home pose and the hand's command interface must match the IsaacArmSystem /
_home_comment: Matches the URDF <state_interface> initial_value. MuJoCo's <keyframe> has joint7 = -0.785; ros2_control uses +0.7853, and we follow ros2_control so hardware and simulator agree at t=0.
_armature_comment: Rotor inertia (kg*m^2) from the MuJoCo model this project tunes against (xml/fr3_with_ft_sensor/fr3.xml). The URDF cannot express it, so the import leaves only link inertia; the wrist links are ~15x lighter than their rotor, which puts sqrt(kp/I) far above what the ROS round trip tolerates and fr3_joint7 sits in a limit cycle.
_position_gain_comment: NVIDIA's franka.usd authors physics:stiffness 400 / damping 80 per DEGREE; these are the same numbers in per-radian units. Stiffness matters because the position-mode threshold is 0.015 rad and a joint carrying 25 Nm droops by torque/stiffness.
_velocity_gain_comment: Velocity mode drives with damping only; this is the velocity tracking gain, started from MuJoCo's actuators_velocity.xml kv.
_torque_damping_comment: Left at what the importer derives from the URDF's <dynamics damping='0.003'> (0.172 in per-radian units). Adding more was measured to break joint_space_impedance_controller's moves, because the extra drag is not in the controller's model.
_hand_gain_comment: The gripper is position-driven in every control mode, as in MuJoCo. Prismatic, so N/m and N*s/m.
